{"needs_review":false,"confidence":1,"citations":[{"source_id":"ch_7675130d841f32c8","quote":"1) Frito-Lay North America (FLNA), which includes our branded convenient food businesses in the United States and Canada; 2) Quaker Foods North America (QFNA), which includes our branded convenient food businesses... in the United States and Canada; 3) PepsiCo Beverages North America (PBNA)... in the United States and Canada; 4) Latin America (LatAm)... in Latin America; 5) Europe... in Europe; 6) Africa, Middle East and South Asia (AMESA)... in Africa, the Middle East and South Asia; and 7) Asia Pacific, Australia, and New Zealand and China region (APAC)... in Asia Pacific, Australia and New Zealand, and China region."}],"answer":"As of FY2022, PepsiCo is organized into seven reportable segments (divisions) corresponding to its primary operating geographies:

3. PepsiCo Beverages North America (PBNA) — United States and Canada
4. Latin America (LatAm) — Latin America
